Sub $5M circulating market cap for the wallet that is gonna usher in next-gen privacy + post quantum features for Ethereum doesn’t seem like the right valuation if you ask me… but what do I know

Below graphics are from their website https://t.co/MhsaRJJ2hm:

Right now their biz model is charge a fee on in-wallet swaps-> fees go to DAO treasury -> token holders vote on what to do with fees (AFAIK revenue has been used for buybacks, can track buybacks at buybacks.ambire.eth)

Revenue to date has been pretty minimal (~$1m), but the bet is that mobile app + first EVM wallet to implement privacy + post quantum features grows the business.

Their wallet product is genuinely great, so it’s just about getting distribution. Certainly an uphill battle, but feel like that’s priced in at these valuations.

Longed some $BTC at ~77k, betting on this wick being the local bottom. With 74-76k as strong support and Binance can cover the losses, downside is limited

Net buying power on BTC should be pretty strong as Binance likely needs to buy back 1.4bn at market and hacker can’t dump quickly. Those who were worried all sold. I’m much more cautious on alts though. 

Binance will recover but this incident reminds everyone about 10th Oct again and will lead to faster growth on trading volume for Hyperliquid and the DEXes

With ICE and Stan Druckenmiler invested into Hyperliquid and Binance getting the biggest hack within 24 hours, is this  telling us where the future is heading to?

The hacker must hate Binance so much that he seems to be timing this hack in October, after Hyperliquid just announced the most important investment ever. What a simulated world we live in….
